Query.description: Trimmed, case-insensitive substring match on project/label name or task summary.

OwnerBinding.name: X-Timekeeper-Owner
OwnerBinding.description: Optional expected owner for a bound client session: canonical unpadded base64url of its UTF-8 owner ID. Invalid encoding: 400; a different authenticated owner: 401 OWNER_CHANGED before any resource read or mutation. Omission retains stateless token-owner semantics.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: Required for cookie-authenticated unsafe methods; obtained from /auth/session. Unnecessary for bearer authentication.

AccountKey.name: key
AccountKey.description: Canonical unpadded base64url UTF-8 owner ID; administrator account management only. Never selects a business-data owner.

UndoPreference.name: X-Timekeeper-Undo
UndoPreference.description: Request a ten-minute undo offer for this work-session edit or deletion.

IfMatchOptional.name: If-Match
IfMatchOptional.description: Use the current strong ETag to replace an existing asset. Exactly one of If-Match or If-None-Match: * is required.

IfNoneMatchStar.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatchStar.description: Create only when the asset is absent; use this instead of If-Match for new uploads.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked bearer token, or OWNER_CHANGED when its authenticated owner differs from the expected session owner.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer realm="timekeeper"; invalid credentials additionally use error="invalid_token".

403.description: Authenticated token lacks the required read/write permission.

404.description: Resource or referenced resource does not exist in the authenticated owner scope.
